name: Sarajevo cash-waqf commercial capital
description: Cash endowments supported commercial finance in an Ottoman–Venetian trade network.

date.basis: The scholarly abstract scopes the evidence to the 1580s, not a single-year transaction.

events.statement: A historian’s study reports Sarajevo cash waqfs supporting Ottoman–Venetian trade in the 1580s, with local artisan associations involved in founding and administering such endowments.
events.scope: Sarajevo commercial activity in the 1580s as summarized in the article abstract.

evidence.supports: Summarizes the 1580s Sarajevo cash-waqf role in Ottoman–Venetian commercial finance and artisan associations.

earliest_record.rationale: The dated episode anchors this community-scoped capability; earlier practices are not excluded.

caveats: The repository provided only an abstract, not the article or underlying records. Individual contracts, financing amounts, access and whether the same associations founded every endowment remain unverified.

research.note: Initial source pass.  Independent review checked only Stefini’s repository abstract, which explicitly states the 1580s trade context and artisan associations; this does not constitute review of the full article or underlying archival evidence.
